title: Resolution urging FIFA to pay NYC its promised $1 million
summary: This resolution calls on FIFA to pay New York City the $1 million "legacy contribution" it promised to World Cup host cities. The City spent an estimated $90 million hosting 2026 World Cup matches and events but only expected about $51 million in related tax revenue. A news report from August 2026 found FIFA had not actually made the promised payments to host cities.
